Backup generators, Carbanti active sensor stack, and almost new aft deflector shields, local-made but nothing wrong with them.|Junkyard operator describing the Nighthawk|<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
This '''individual''' was the owner of a junkyard on [[Jovan Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Jovan system/Legends|Jovan system]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the operator sold the [[B-7 light freighter]] ''[[Nighthawk]]'' to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] after a long period of haggling. The operator gave the Jedi Master a good price for the ship because it needed repairs in order to fly.<ref name="YDR" />
